d:
What if your roommate could hear every single thought you had… with absolutely no filter?
Living with your best friend means sharing clothes, stealing food, judging each other’s choices and knowing way too much about each other. But what happens when all those thoughts you keep to yourself suddenly become impossible to hide? From brutally honest opinions to secret judgements and the most unfiltered inner monologues, watch what happens when sharing a room also means sharing what’s going on inside your head.
